name: limit_note_outside_the_sheet
why: ENTRY E2-bis, the limit. The coordinates of a note are those of the SHEET, and a note put outside the sheet **exists, is counted, and is not on the paper**. No error would say so: the count goes up, the operation answers «done», and what reaches the workshop is a drawing without that line.
_what_changes_compared_to_the_twin: One argument: `y_mm`. The twin sets it to **250**, inside an A3 sheet 297 high; here it is **9999**. Same operation, same text, same drawing, same part — it is the VALUE of an argument that changes, not which argument is passed.
defect_caught: That the check on the sheet disappears. It is the kind of guard that is written once and never seen to fire, so nobody notices the day it stops working: from that day the notes outside the sheet would come back «done». The message must also NAME the number asked for and the size of the sheet, otherwise whoever reads it does not know by how much they were wrong.

expect.why: same part as the twin: if the two started from different geometries, they would not be a pair
the part must be on disk before the view names it
the refusal must be the one on the POSITION, not the one on «it is not a drawing»: without this expectation, a refusal for the wrong reason would pass for a good one
the drawing must be in the same state as the twin up to the step that changes
